title: Corrupt Counseling - This Treatment Will Demolish You
description: You signed up for counseling… but you didn’t read the fine print. This is psychological domination masked as clinical care. You came seeking help for your compulsions, and I welcomed you in; clipboard in hand, professional tone, reviewing your intake form with apparent concern. But behind every word I speak is a calculated takeover. Once I drop you into the world of nothing, your “treatment” begins. You’ll be conditioned to obey your obsession, pushed to act on your cravings, and ordered to serve through the very desire you once tried to manage. By the end of this session, you’ll understand: you were never meant to get better. You were meant to fall deeper. This is corrupt counseling at its finest - disguised control, seductive domination, and total behavioral rewiring.
author: Mistress Amethyst
